# Taste in the Creative OS Harness

The upstream package, including all 14 skills, scripts, libraries, assets and references, is preserved byte for byte. This adapter connects that method to the existing Harness; it is not an abridged skill.

- Start from the real task, incumbent UI, approved Foundation, references and confirmed change. This is the complete legacy snapshot, retained for reproducibility and explicit legacy methods. Current `existing`, `app-screen` and `public-page` work routes through the separately versioned `taste-v2` package and its adapter, not the retired redesign entry. Optional `dials-v1` reads the entire original dial-driven skill; explicit DESIGN_VARIANCE, MOTION_INTENSITY and VISUAL_DENSITY values override its defaults. Missing values are not invented preferences, and dials are not falsely attributed to current v2.
- Preserve approved typography, brand, tokens, component reuse, framework and accessibility. Treat upstream house-style bans and stack defaults as contextual design heuristics. Novelty must serve the task; a justified brand color, centered layout or established font is not evidence of AI authorship. Do not add imagery, gradients or motion just to look premium. Maintain complete content, critical task states and reduced-motion alternatives.
- In a review session, use the original diagnosis/critique methodology without executing its fix steps. Return actionable evidence, impact and a remedy in the existing Harness JSON schema. Do not edit, perform another agent's task, change scope, invent research, score aesthetics as measured quality, or claim human acceptance.
- In implementation, translate the full method into the confirmed scope inside the isolated worktree. A new direction or asset proposal needing approval goes back through the existing Foundation/scope flow. An existing approved fix does not require a second selection workflow. Do not silently expand a local fix into a full redesign.
- Scripts, image libraries and code templates remain available in the complete snapshot. Their presence grants no permission to run installers, connect a browser to an unrelated project, fetch imagery or install dependencies. The Harness controls tools, capture, source binding, output, bounded review, recapture and permissions. Use supplied assets and verified credits first; do not use random placeholder photographs as product evidence. For a new approved public-page brief, use the direction/idea/imagery/layout/browser-inspection method with permitted tools; preserve unavailable-step limitations rather than substituting a claimed script pass.
- A screenshot does not verify motion, hover, keyboard, error recovery or unseen routes. Use supplied interaction records and implementation evidence; state missing coverage. The complete source snapshot proves availability, not that the model read or applied every file.

## Reading routes

Current existing/app surfaces and public pages use `taste-v2`. This legacy package is reference-only unless the explicit `dials-v1` profile selects `skills/taste-skill-v1/SKILL.md`. All 14 original skills and resources remain available, without combining incompatible styles automatically.
